evals.prompt: In this Obsidian vault, run /learn-note Context Switch from the current focus. Do not start an interactive teaching or quiz loop.
evals.expected_output: Creates or resumes notes/context-switch.md, links it to the current lesson and links the lesson back, records the note as Learning, preserves the lesson status and Current Focus, and appends one exploration history event.
assertions: The source is resolved from the unique Current Focus rather than guessed from an arbitrary lesson.
The note follows the protocol headings and contains a path-qualified Source link.
The source lesson has exactly one reciprocal note link and its progress status/date remain unchanged.
The note has a Learning progress row with Last Learned updated and Last Tested preserved.
MAP.md remains unchanged for a side exploration and HISTORY.md gains one append-only exploration event.
The response does not start a quiz or mark the note or source Mastered.

evals.prompt: Resume /learn-note Context Switch in a workspace containing a partial note. Preserve the human observation in the partial note and complete the durable connections without starting a quiz.
evals.expected_output: Completes the partial note in place, preserves human-authored content, repairs missing reciprocal state, and does not duplicate links or history.
assertions: The existing note is updated in place rather than replaced wholesale.
Missing source link/state effects are repaired idempotently and no duplicate history event is appended.

evals.prompt: Run /learn-note Context Switch from the current focus and explicitly promote this exploration into MAP.md as a main-path choice. Do not start a quiz.
evals.expected_output: Creates the normal note contract and adds the note path to MAP.md only because promotion was explicit, with a Learning progress row.
assertions: The promoted note appears in MAP.md exactly once with a path-qualified notes link.
Without the explicit promotion wording, the same note operation would leave MAP.md unchanged.

evals.prompt: Run /learn-note Context Switch from the vault root where more than one workspace can supply the source. Make no changes until the source workspace is unambiguous.
evals.expected_output: Reports the ambiguity and asks the learner to choose a workspace/source without writing a note or changing any state file.
assertions: No note, progress, map, source, or history file changes before disambiguation.
The response identifies the workspace/source ambiguity and asks for a choice.
